evidence_levels.vendor_step_verified: Manufacturer CAD/STEP/DXF imported and GLB bounds verified.
evidence_levels.datasheet_parametric: Built from manufacturer mechanical drawings, then GLB bounds verified.
evidence_levels.measured_parametric: Built from calipers and orthographic photos of the exact part.
evidence_levels.estimated_package_model: Generic package model exists but has not been traced to a source drawing.
evidence_levels.photo_only_placeholder: Only visual/photo or listing evidence; not build-accurate.
evidence_levels.logical_placeholder: Electrical/logical role only; no reliable physical geometry.

12V_IN.model_goal: Represent only the real part used in the bench build, or mark it off-board if it remains external.
12V_IN.web_notes: If kept off-board, it should be modeled as an external supply/cable rather than a board-mounted block. If using a PD trigger board, use its exact listing or photos.

U1.model_goal: Model the purchased MP1584 buck module board, including pads, trim pot, inductor, and tallest parts. The official MP1584 IC CAD is not enough.
U1.web_notes: The MP1584 IC has official CAD; the Amazon buck module board usually does not. Need exact module listing or photos with scale before solder endpoints are trusted.

GALVO_PSU.model_goal: Measure the exact KPDS0-12A kit supply board, connector centers, mounting holes, and live-voltage keepout.
GALVO_PSU.web_notes: Kit PSU appears KPDS0-12A/KPD50-R8. Web data is weak; use the photos and real board for connector coordinates and keepout.

U3.model_goal: Confirm whether the ordered Hosyond board matches Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 dimensions. If it matches, use official DXF/PDF; otherwise model the board from calipers.
U3.web_notes: Official Espressif DevKitC-1 docs provide dimensions/DXF/header tables, but the purchased Hosyond clone must be checked against that outline.

U4.model_goal: Use the exact purchased MCP4822 package. If PDIP-8, one verified DIP-8 part model can serve MCP4822 and TL072.
U4.web_notes: If the purchased part is MCP4822-E/P, the package can be modeled from manufacturer package drawings/CAD without user caliper work.

C10.model_goal: Verify the capacitor package actually purchased. 100 nF could be through-hole or SMD depending on kit/source.
C10.web_notes: Only web-solvable if the actual part is 0805. If using through-hole ceramic caps on perfboard, model those instead.

U5.model_goal: Use the exact purchased TL072 package. If PDIP-8, share the verified DIP-8 geometry.
U5.web_notes: If the purchased part is TL072CP, the package can be modeled from TI package drawings without user caliper work.

VREF.model_goal: Do not finalize until the 2.048 V reference implementation is chosen.
VREF.web_notes: Can be web-solved after choosing a specific reference IC/module. Until then it is logical only.

R_XY.model_goal: Replace the logical resistor-network block with individual parts and real solder endpoints.
R_XY.web_notes: Needs split into individual resistors before geometry can be exact.

C_ANALOG.model_goal: Verify actual capacitor package and place each decoupling/filter capacitor separately.
C_ANALOG.web_notes: Only web-solvable if the actual capacitors are SMD 0805. Bench perfboard may use through-hole parts.

GALVO_DRV.model_goal: Measure the exact galvo driver board and enter every power/signal connector pin by label before wiring guidance.
GALVO_DRV.web_notes: Galvo driver board dimensions/pin labels are kit-specific and should not be inferred from generic 20K scanner listings.

GALVOS.model_goal: Model galvo block, scanner mirror clearance, connector/cable exit, and mounting orientation.
GALVOS.web_notes: Scanner block dimensions, mirror clearance, and connector/cable exit depend on the exact kit.

TEST_LASER.model_goal: Model the actual low-power test laser only after purchase/selection.
TEST_LASER.web_notes: Choose a specific low-power test laser before modeling.

BEAM_STOP.model_goal: Represent the real beam stop used on the bench, including height and safe beam area.
BEAM_STOP.web_notes: This is a safety fixture; geometry should match the actual bench stop.

Q1.model_goal: Verify the 2N7000 package, lead order, and flat-face orientation.
Q1.web_notes: TO-92 body can be modeled from package drawings once the purchased package and lead order are confirmed.

R9/R10/R16.model_goal: Split into R9, R10, and R16 as separate measured parts with real endpoints.
R9/R10/R16.web_notes: Needs split into individual R9/R10/R16 parts before geometry can be exact.

SW3.model_goal: Confirm purchased switch exactly matches Omron D2F-01L before trusting this model.
SW3.web_notes: If the actual switch is Omron D2F-01L, datasheet/CAD dimensions can drive the model. Generic Amazon lever switches are not interchangeable.

KEY.model_goal: Model the actual key switch body, nut/washer, panel clearance, and terminal lugs.
KEY.web_notes: Key switches vary heavily; model the actual purchased switch or choose a known part number.

LASER.model_goal: Model body diameter/length, driver board if separate, wire exit, beam axis, and mounting clearance.
LASER.web_notes: Vendor page locks electrical/optical identity. Mechanical body dimensions still need vendor drawing or product-specific confirmation before beam-axis model is trusted.

CAM.model_goal: Do not finalize camera pin endpoints until the exact module and FPC pinout are verified.
CAM.web_notes: OV5640 module body and FPC pinout vary by seller. Need exact product page before connector model/pinout is trusted.

IMU.model_goal: Model exact breakout dimensions and header/pad locations after part selection.
IMU.web_notes: GY-521 clones are common but board layouts vary; a named listing or photo with scale is needed for exact headers/mounting holes.
